title: Card-Guaranteed Rooming-List Nights in Group Room Blocks Cancellation Damages
content:
On a Group Room Blocks cancellation, the confirmed Group Block Rate reservations naming the block that a guest's own card guarantees carry their own reservation penalties for their guests, and their nights are excluded from the chargeable room nights as follows:

- when there are such reservations and their nights are **no more than 25 percent** of the nights of all the confirmed Group Block Rate reservations naming the block, all their nights are excluded;
- when their nights are **more than 25 percent**, **0.5** (one half) of them are excluded, rounded down;
- when there are none, nothing is excluded.

The excluded nights come off the chargeable room nights before the damages are worked on what remains.

### Questions the rule answers

**Which reservations are compared?** The organiser's Room Reservations that name the block, are booked at the Group Block Rate and stand confirmed: the nights of those guaranteed by a guest's own card, against the nights of all of them.

**Are reservations guaranteed to the group master account excluded?** No; only nights guaranteed by a guest's own card are excluded.

**Is a share of exactly 25 percent fully excluded?** Yes; 25 percent is "no more than 25 percent".

### Worked exclusions (hypothetical block, 200 nights of confirmed Group Block Rate reservations naming it)

| Nights guaranteed by guests' own cards | Share | Excluded |
|---|---|---|
| 40 | 20 percent | 40 |
| 50 | 25 percent | 50 |
| 51 | 25.5 percent | 25 (one half of 51 is 25.5, rounded down) |
| 0 | — | 0 |
